entries.text: PSBT_OUT_TAP_INTERNAL_KEY, tweaked by the root of PSBT_OUT_TAP_TREE or, without it, by some script tree, MUST produce the output's P2TR key.

entries.text: Before adding inputs or outputs, the Constructor MUST check the corresponding modification flag and add only what it permits.

entries.note: The linked context records only whether each listed input needs a locktime, not the required type or value. Success confirms field presence for listed requirements; it does not establish that all added inputs or their chosen spend branches were covered.
entries.text: For an input with a required spend-branch locktime, the Constructor MUST set the corresponding required time- or height-based locktime field.

entries.gap: Sees only the signatures signature discovery reaches, not those in arbitrary finalized scripts or every Taproot script path.
entries.note: Preservation is checked using discoverable signatures. Signature discovery does not cover arbitrary finalized scripts or all Taproot script paths.
entries.text: When adding an input with a required locktime, the Constructor MUST NOT change the determined transaction locktime if any existing input has a signature.

entries.text: If Has SIGHASH_SINGLE is true, the Constructor MUST identify the signed SINGLE input/output pairs and insert equal numbers of inputs and outputs before each affected pair.

entries.text: Before signing an input with PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO, the Signer MUST verify that it hashes to the input's previous txid and agrees with any PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO.

entries.note: Not applicable without PSBT_IN_REDEEM_SCRIPT, so a P2SH spend missing it passes this rule; ROLE-S-3 and ROLE-S-4 are then Incomplete. Takes the spent output from either UTXO field; without one it is Incomplete.
entries.text: Before signing an input with PSBT_IN_REDEEM_SCRIPT, the Signer MUST verify that the spent output is P2SH of that script.

entries.note: Run by evaluate_for_signing with the input and signature kind the caller selects; evaluate_signing infers the kind from the spent script. Without a spent output, or a P2SH spend without its redeemScript, it is Incomplete.
entries.text: The Signer MUST NOT create a non-witness signature for an input with PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO, nor a signature of a kind the spent script does not take.

entries.note: Not observable in the PSBT: the check uses the Signer's private key. GEN-SP-6 checks a supplied spend public key the same way.
entries.text: Before signing an SP input, the Signer MUST fail unless its spend private key, tweaked as REF-7 describes, gives the spent P2TR output key.

entries.note: Run by evaluate_dnssec_proofs with a supplied time; without one it is Incomplete. Uses dnssec-prover, which enforces the DNSSEC algorithm policy and resolves CNAME and DNAME. TXT character-strings are concatenated in RDATA order.
entries.text: A Signer that validates a PSBT_OUT_DNSSEC_PROOF MUST validate it as REF-6 describes.

entries.note: Not observable in the PSBT: the rule needs evidence of what the wallet displayed.
entries.text: A Signer that displays a BIP353 name without homograph precautions MUST display non-ASCII user and domain identifiers as raw punycode.

entries.note: Not observable in the PSBT: the rule needs evidence of what the Signer showed and that the user approved.
entries.text: A Signer that recognizes a BIP322 PSBT MUST inform the user of the message and the address it signs for, and MUST sign only on the user's approval.

entries.gap: Exempts PSBT_GLOBAL_TX_MODIFIABLE from comparison and does not restrict which fields the Signer adds.
entries.note: The linked transition check preserves existing records but exempts TX_MODIFIABLE from comparison. It does not restrict newly added fields or verify that flag changes are permitted.
entries.text: The Signer MUST only add data: every key-value pair it received, including unknown types, MUST be in the PSBT it returns.

entries.note: Compares the PSBT the Signer received with the one it returned. Applies to inputs with PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE that gained a signature; a 64-byte Schnorr signature uses SIGHASH_DEFAULT.
entries.text: Every signature the Signer adds to an input with PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE MUST use that sighash type.

entries.note: Compares the PSBT the Signer received with the one it returned. For an SP input that gained a signature, it must be in PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG, not a partial or script-path signature, and verify as a key-path signature by the spent output key. Missing transaction data returns Incomplete.
entries.text: The Signer MUST write the BIP340 signature for an SP input to PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG.

entries.gap: An input already finalized with a Taproot script path is Incomplete, because its witness does not say which items are signatures. Finalized P2WSH spends are not searched.
entries.note: Compares the sighash types of the input's signatures: partial and Taproot signature fields, and those in a finalized key-path or legacy witness. evaluate_finalizing applies it to the input the Finalizer received, where every signature is in a labeled field. Not applicable without PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE or without a signature.
entries.text: If PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE is present, the Finalizer MUST refuse to finalize an input if any of its signatures uses a different sighash type.

entries.note: Performed with ECDSA (k256) over the BIP143 signature message for a P2WPKH or P2WSH spend, bare or inside P2SH, and the legacy message otherwise. The signature must be strict DER; a high S is accepted, as consensus does. A missing UTXO, redeem script or witness script, a script code with OP_CODESEPARATOR, or a witness version above 0 returns Incomplete. Runs after ROLE-F-3 and ROLE-F-5.
entries.text: Before finalizing an input, the Finalizer MUST verify each PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG it uses as REF-5 describes.

entries.gap: A BIP328 derivation is found only through a PSBT_IN_TAP_BIP32_DERIVATION with the aggregate key's fingerprint, not a synthetic PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB.
entries.note: Performed with BIP327 PartialSigVerify (the musig2 crate) for every session with no aggregated signature. A session missing a participant's nonce, or whose plain key cannot be related to a listed aggregate key, is Incomplete.
entries.text: Before finalizing an input, the Finalizer MUST verify each PSBT_IN_MUSIG2_PARTIAL_SIG it would aggregate as REF-5 describes.

entries.gap: Does not execute scripts, so script-hash and Taproot script-path spends are Incomplete rather than Verified; does not determine which inputs had enough data to finalize.
entries.note: Checks a finalized input against its spent script. P2PKH and P2WPKH must reveal a key that hashes to the committed hash; P2SH and P2WSH must reveal a script that hashes to the commitment; wrapped segwit uses a scriptSig of only the redeem script push; native segwit has no scriptSig; P2TR has a witness and no scriptSig. A matching template is not Verified on its own: a P2PKH or P2WPKH signature, bare or inside P2SH, is verified with ECDSA as ROLE-F-4 does, and P2SH, P2WSH and Taproot script-path spends are Incomplete because script satisfaction is not checked. A Taproot key-path spend is Verified here; ROLE-F-10 verifies its signature. Other spent scripts, or a missing UTXO, return Incomplete. evaluate_finalizing applies it to every input whose final fields the Finalizer set or changed, and fails an input whose final fields it removed. Whether every input with enough data was finalized is not checked.
entries.text: For each input with enough data to pass validation, the Finalizer MUST construct its finalized scriptSig and scriptWitness fields as applicable.

entries.note: Supply before and after contexts for the same input. Only fields present before finalization are required to be retained; optional fields do not become mandatory.
entries.text: When clearing finalized input metadata, the Finalizer MUST retain existing PREVIOUS_TXID, OUTPUT_INDEX, SEQUENCE, REQUIRED_TIME_LOCKTIME and REQUIRED_HEIGHT_LOCKTIME fields.

entries.note: Compares the input before and after finalizing. The final witness must be exactly one element equal to the PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG it had, with no annex, and that field must be gone. GEN-SP-6 rejects a finalized input that keeps PSBT_IN_SP_TWEAK or PSBT_IN_SP_SPEND_BIP32_DERIVATION.
entries.text: For an input with PSBT_IN_SP_TWEAK, the Finalizer MUST construct a single-element PSBT_IN_FINAL_SCRIPTWITNESS from its PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG, and remove PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG.

entries.note: After removing an annex, a P2TR final witness with two or more elements must end with a leaf script and a control block that commit to the spent output key. Field cleanup is BIP174 guidance and is not checked here.
entries.text: For an input finalized via script path, the final witness MUST consist of the script inputs, followed by the leaf script and control block.

evidence.label: BIP341 - Script validation rules; BIP174 - Input Finalizer

entries.note: Applies to a P2TR final witness with one element after removing any annex. The signature is checked against the spent output key with the annex committed; missing transaction data returns Incomplete.
entries.text: For a P2TR input finalized via key path, the final witness MUST be a single signature, followed by any annex, that verifies against the spent output key.

isolating.description: PSBTv2 with an input that is signed but not finalized
PSBTv2 with an empty PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT
PSBTv2 with a finalized unsigned input and a silent payment output without a script
BIP-174 combiner result, not finalized

entries.gap: Tests final-field presence and some version 2 fields; it does not build the transaction or establish that each spend is satisfied.
entries.note: The linked check tests final-field presence and some v2 transaction fields, without constructing the transaction or establishing spend satisfaction. It currently rejects present empty output scripts.
entries.text: The Extractor MUST extract only when every input has the final fields its spend needs and the version-specific fields can build the transaction.

isolating.description: PSBTs for different transactions
PSBTv2s with different required lock times

entries.note: Validate each source and result before comparing identifiers. Equal identifiers do not establish a consistent metadata merge; apply ROLE-B-2 separately.
entries.text: A Combiner MUST NOT combine PSBTs whose transaction identifiers differ.

isolating.description: Combined PSBT drops the second signer's partial signatures
Combined PSBT adds partial signatures neither PSBT holds
PSBTv2s whose PSBT_IN_SEQUENCE conflicts, combined to a third sequence

entries.gap: Key preservation and supplied-value selection exist; comprehensive merge consistency is not established.
entries.note: The linked check preserves source keys and selects supplied values after identity comparison. It does not establish comprehensive consistency between merged metadata fields.
entries.text: A successful combination MUST preserve source key-value data in the corresponding maps. For conflicting duplicate keys, choose a supplied value or fail. Fail where a consistent merge cannot be produced.
The value of PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION, or 0 when the field is absent.
A field whose key type the field registry below lists for its map. Other key types are unknown fields.
The output an input spends: its PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO, or else the output of its PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO at the input's output index.
An input with PSBT_IN_FINAL_SCRIPTSIG or PSBT_IN_FINAL_SCRIPTWITNESS.
A signature in an input of the PSBT a role returned that the same input of the PSBT it received did not have.
Inputs Modifiable, Outputs Modifiable and Has SIGHASH_SINGLE are bits 0, 1 and 2 of PSBT_GLOBAL_TX_MODIFIABLE.

evidence.label: BIP370 - Unique Identification; BIP375 - Unique Identification

entries.text: For version 0, the txid of PSBT_GLOBAL_UNSIGNED_TX. For version 2, the txid of the unsigned transaction BIP370 builds for unique identification. Under BIP375, an output's PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_INFO is used in place of its PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT when building that transaction.

A PSBT with PSBT_GLOBAL_GENERIC_SIGNED_MESSAGE whose first input spends output 0 of the to_spend transaction for that message and the input's spent script, and whose only output is a zero-value OP_RETURN. Recognition needs the first input's spent output; without it, the rules about BIP322 PSBTs are Incomplete.
An output with PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_INFO.
The two public keys of a silent payment address. The sender combines the scan key with its inputs' keys to derive a shared secret; the output pays the spend key tweaked by that secret.
The address a recipient publishes, encoding its scan key and spend key. A PSBT carries the two keys in PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_INFO.
An integer m the recipient uses to tweak its spend key, so payments to one scan key can be told apart. Label 0 is reserved for change; PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_LABEL carries it.

A scan key multiplied by an input's private key (PSBT_IN_SP_ECDH_SHARE) or by the sum of the eligible inputs' private keys (PSBT_GLOBAL_SP_ECDH_SHARE). Shares let the output script be computed without revealing private keys to whoever computes it.

A proof that an ECDH share was made with the same private key as a public key, without revealing that key (PSBT_IN_SP_DLEQ, PSBT_GLOBAL_SP_DLEQ). It lets other parties check a share they did not make.

evidence.label: BIP352 - Inputs For Shared Secret Derivation

entries.text: An input whose key contributes to the BIP352 shared secret: a P2PKH, P2WPKH, P2SH-P2WPKH or P2TR spend, except a P2TR spend that shows its internal key is the BIP341 NUMS point.
Use the shared locktime type supported by all constrained inputs and take its maximum. Prefer height when both types work. With no input requirement, use fallback locktime, or zero if absent.

entries.note: Derivation requires complete eligible-input context. Missing public keys or shares cannot count as successful derivation.
entries.text: For output derivation, select at least one eligible input. Use the scan key’s global ECDH share, or sum the matching shares from all eligible inputs. Public keys and eligibility must be established for the inputs included in the computation.

entries.note: A proof check requires the matching proof and complete verification inputs. Summing only recoverable public keys or trusting unrelated derivation keys does not establish the required aggregate key.
entries.text: Global verification uses the sum of all eligible-input public keys; per-input verification uses that input’s key. Use the matching scan key, share and proof with BIP374 VerifyProof.

entries.note: The ordering stated here follows BIP375 prose. The published helper uses output-map ordering, which can produce different results.
entries.text: Assign k per scan key after sorting silent-payment codes lexicographically. Break identical-code ties by ascending output index, then derive the BIP352 script using the selected shared secret.

PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG: an ECDSA signature by its public key under the BIP143 signature message for a segwit v0 spend, or the legacy message otherwise. PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG: a BIP340 signature by the spent output key under the BIP341 key-path message for its hash type. PSBT_IN_TAP_SCRIPT_SIG: a BIP340 signature by its x-only key under the BIP341 script-path message for its leaf. PSBT_IN_MUSIG2_PARTIAL_SIG: BIP327 PartialSigVerify under its session's aggregate key, tweaks and nonces.

Validate the RFC 9102 chain from the DNS root to the name's TXT records. Each RRSIG's inception is no later than the current time and its expiry no earlier than it, or up to an hour earlier only when a delay between construction and signing is likely. Ignore TXT records not beginning with "bitcoin:", and refuse the proof if more than one does.
Take P from the input's P2TR PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO. Compute d = (b_spend + tweak) mod n, and negate d when dG has odd y. The key matches when x(dG) equals P.

For each silent-payment output's scan key: once the output has PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT, there is a global ECDH share, or per-input shares on at least one input and every eligible input. A global share has a global DLEQ proof, the PSBT has an eligible input, every eligible input has a public key, and the proof verifies for the sum of those keys, the scan key and the share. An eligible input's share has a DLEQ proof, the input has a public key, and the proof verifies for that key, the scan key and the share.

With silent-payment outputs, no input spends a SegWit version 2 or later output, PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE is SIGHASH_ALL (or SIGHASH_DEFAULT on a P2TR input), and every signature uses SIGHASH_ALL (or SIGHASH_DEFAULT for a 64-byte Schnorr signature).
A silent-payment output with PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT has the ECDH shares and input public keys its derivation needs (REF-2), and its script is the BIP352 output script, with k assigned as REF-4 describes.

A finalized input keeps neither PSBT_IN_SP_TWEAK nor PSBT_IN_SP_SPEND_BIP32_DERIVATION. An input with PSBT_IN_SP_SPEND_BIP32_DERIVATION has PSBT_IN_SP_TWEAK. An input with PSBT_IN_SP_TWEAK has a PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO whose script is P2TR. Every spend key, plus the tweak times G, has the x-coordinate of the spent P2TR output key.
The Creator SHOULD set fallback locktime. Its absence means zero when no input requires a locktime.
A Creator that is also the Constructor may omit TX_MODIFIABLE if no other entity will add inputs or outputs.
Both required locktime types may be set. If the chosen spend branch uses one type, that field can be the only one set.
A Constructor may close additions by clearing the appropriate modification flags or removing TX_MODIFIABLE.

Updaters SHOULD add available input UTXOs and known scripts and BIP32 origins at the applicable input/output scopes. PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO SHOULD be present for inputs spending non-segwit outputs and can be present for segwit ones; PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO SHOULD only be present for inputs spending segwit outputs.

entries.note: Sequence-setting permission does not authorize arbitrary PSBT format conversion.
entries.text: When adding a PSBT format version, use the highest required version as recommended by BIP174. A v2 Updater can set sequence.

entries.note: BIP375 describes a privacy alternative as setting the value to zero. Do not assume this uses BIP376’s separate four-byte-fingerprint encoding.
entries.text: Updaters SHOULD supply BIP32 derivation fields for P2PKH, P2WPKH and P2SH-P2WPKH inputs so public keys are available. BIP375 permits setting the derivation value to zero to withhold origin information.
Updaters may supply scan/spend derivation information and a label for change detection.
For an SP spend using BIP32, the Updater SHOULD add SP_SPEND_BIP32_DERIVATION. To hide origin information, it can use a four-byte zero fingerprint and no derivation paths.

The Signer SHOULD generate per-input shares and proofs for eligible inputs whose private keys it has, or a global share and proof when it has all eligible private keys, and compute missing scripts when share coverage is complete.

entries.note: This general cleanup recommendation does not weaken the mandatory three-field SP cleanup in ROLE-F-8.
entries.text: Empty scriptSig and nonexistent scriptWitness final fields SHOULD remain unset. Other input metadata SHOULD be cleared except UTXOs, unknown fields and fields retained by the version or extension rules.

entries.note: A recommendation; no validator fails a PSBT that keeps these fields.
entries.text: BIP371: after constructing PSBT_IN_FINAL_SCRIPTWITNESS, Finalizers SHOULD remove PSBT_IN_TAP_KEY_SIG, PSBT_IN_TAP_SCRIPT_SIG, PSBT_IN_TAP_LEAF_SCRIPT, PSBT_IN_TAP_BIP32_DERIVATION, PSBT_IN_TAP_INTERNAL_KEY and PSBT_IN_TAP_MERKLE_ROOT.

entries.note: Because inputs may omit leaves, input derivation leaf hashes are not checked against PSBT_IN_TAP_LEAF_SCRIPT.
entries.text: BIP371: the leaves in PSBT_IN_TAP_LEAF_SCRIPT SHOULD be those the signers of the input are expected to be able to sign for.

entries.note: Taproot rules take the spent output from either UTXO field.
entries.text: BIP371: a Taproot input may carry only PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO, since a Taproot signature commits to every spent amount and script.
A PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB SHOULD be the public key at the highest hardened derivation index, so the unhardened child keys in the transaction can be derived from it.
A Signer may refuse to sign a segwit input that has no PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO.
Without PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE, a Signer SHOULD sign using SIGHASH_ALL, but may use any sighash type.

entries.note: General validation does not check PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG signatures; ROLE-F-4 does before finalizing.
entries.text: A PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG value SHOULD be a valid ECDSA signature for its public key, as it would be pushed to the stack.

BIP373: an Updater that knows a MuSig2 aggregate key in a Taproot output may add PSBT_IN_MUSIG2_PARTICIPANT_PUBKEYS, SHOULD add PSBT_IN_TAP_BIP32_DERIVATION for the participant keys, and for a key derived from the aggregate key SHOULD add that derivation, which follows BIP328 unless a PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB gives the synthetic xpub.
BIP373: Updaters SHOULD add PSBT_OUT_MUSIG2_PARTICIPANT_PUBKEYS and PSBT_OUT_TAP_BIP32_DERIVATION to outputs, as for inputs, to aid change detection.

BIP373: a Signer SHOULD find its participation through PSBT_IN_MUSIG2_PARTICIPANT_PUBKEYS and its PSBT_IN_TAP_BIP32_DERIVATION keys, and SHOULD add a PSBT_IN_MUSIG2_PUB_NONCE when it has none. Improper nonce use can compromise private keys; see BIP327.
BIP353: wallets creating PSBTs with recipient information from a human-readable name SHOULD include PSBT_OUT_DNSSEC_PROOF. Wallets accepting payment information from external devices MAY examine it.
BIP353: when a proof validates, a Signer SHOULD display the recipient as ₿user@domain.
BIP322: the Signer's presentation SHOULD resemble signing a message rather than a transaction. Creators should keep the message to a few kilobytes and commit to very large messages by hash.
BIP372 (Draft): Signers SHOULD remove PSBT_IN_P2C_TWEAK after PSBT_IN_PARTIAL_SIG is constructed.
BIP375: the Signer SHOULD verify the DLEQ proofs of eligible inputs it has no private keys for, or the global DLEQ proof if it is set, as REF-3 describes.
